description: This file contains unit tests for the webkitpy tool commands, specifically for queries related to test expectations and baselines, including output capturing and platform-specific filtering.

classes.name: PrintExpectationsTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the PrintExpectations command, testing output formatting, platform filtering, full output, exclusion/inclusion keywords, CSV output, and path listing.

classes.name: PrintBaselinesTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the PrintBaselines command, testing baseline listing, platform filtering, and CSV output.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Helper method to run the PrintExpectations command with specified tests and options, capturing and asserting output.

methods.name: test_basic
methods.description: Tests basic output of the PrintExpectations command for a specific platform.

methods.name: test_multiple
methods.description: Tests output for multiple platforms with platform wildcard filtering.

methods.name: test_full
methods.description: Tests full output including bug annotations.

methods.name: test_exclude
methods.description: Tests exclusion of tests based on keywords.

methods.name: test_include
methods.description: Tests inclusion of tests based on keywords.

methods.name: test_basic
methods.description: Tests baseline listing for default platform.

methods.name: test_multiple
methods.description: Tests baseline listing for multiple platforms with wildcard filtering.
